edges.reason: Owned constructor assigns owner, initializing the ownership state variable.
Untrusted msg.sender becomes the initial owner, defining the privileged role.
transferOwnership writes the attacker-influenceable newOwner address.
onlyOwner modifier gates transferOwnership on msg.sender == owner.
The _newOwner parameter flows into the newOwner state variable.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before transferring ownership.
acceptOwnership writes the privileged owner state variable.
acceptOwnership clears newOwner, resetting pending ownership state.
Constructor initializes symbol.
Constructor initializes name.
Constructor initializes decimals.
Constructor sets the total supply.
Constructor mints the entire supply into the deployer's balance entry.
First operand a feeds the addition performed by safeAdd.
Second operand b feeds the addition performed by safeAdd.
safeAdd produces the checked sum stored in local c.
Minuend a feeds the subtraction performed by safeSub.
Subtrahend b feeds the subtraction performed by safeSub.
safeSub produces the checked difference stored in local c.
Operand a feeds the multiplication performed by safeMul.
Operand b feeds the multiplication performed by safeMul.
safeMul produces the checked product stored in local c.
Dividend a feeds the division performed by safeDiv.
Divisor b feeds the division performed by safeDiv.
safeDiv produces the checked quotient stored in local c.
totalSupply reads the _totalSupply state variable.
totalSupply reads balances[address(0)] for the circulating-supply calculation.
totalSupply performs unchecked subtraction outside SafeMath, feeding the unsafe arithmetic node.
balanceOf parameter selects the balances mapping entry to return.
balanceOf reads the balances state variable.
transfer recipient parameter drives the balance credit.
transferred token amount is fed into safeSub/safeAdd inside transfer.
msg.sender selects the debited balance entry in transfer.
transfer mutates the balances state variable.
spender parameter determines the allowance key written by approve.
allowance amount parameter is written into the allowed mapping.
msg.sender indexes the allowed mapping in approve.
approve writes the allowed state variable.
The from parameter controls which balance and allowance entries transferFrom debits.
The to parameter controls the credited balance entry in transferFrom.
The tokens parameter is applied via safeSub/safeAdd inside transferFrom.
msg.sender is the spender whose allowance is decremented in transferFrom.
transferFrom mutates the balances state variable.
transferFrom mutates the allowed state variable.
allowance owner parameter selects the outer mapping key.
allowance spender parameter selects the inner mapping key.
allowance reads the allowed state variable.
The spender parameter is both the allowance key and the external callback target.
The tokens parameter is stored in allowed and forwarded to receiveApproval.
The data parameter is forwarded verbatim into the external receiveApproval callback.
msg.sender indexes the allowed mapping and is passed as 'from' to the callback.
approveAndCall writes the allowed state variable before the external call.
approveAndCall hands execution to an arbitrary spender contract via receiveApproval, enabling reentrant callbacks.
The callback can re-enter after allowed was already written, exposing stale allowance state to the callee.
The owner-supplied tokenAddress parameter determines the arbitrary contract that is called.
The tokens parameter is forwarded to the external ERC20 transfer call.
onlyOwner modifier restricts transferAnyERC20Token to the owner determined by msg.sender.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external call into an arbitrary token contract supplied by the owner.
The external token transfer is directed at the privileged owner address as recipient.
The fallback function is reachable by any external msg.sender and always reverts.

normalization_plan.reason: Operand a exists only to feed the addition inside safeAdd and carries no independent identity.
Operand b exists only to feed the addition inside safeAdd and carries no independent identity.
Returned sum c is a transient local of safeAdd and should be folded into the function.
Minuend a is a transient operand of safeSub.
Subtrahend b is a transient operand of safeSub.
Returned difference c is a transient local of safeSub.
Operand a is a transient operand of safeMul.
Operand b is a transient operand of safeMul.
Returned product c is a transient local of safeMul.
Dividend a is a transient operand of safeDiv.
Divisor b is a transient operand of safeDiv.
Returned quotient c is a transient local of safeDiv.
_newOwner is consumed immediately by transferOwnership when writing newOwner.
tokenOwner only selects the mapping key read by balanceOf.
Recipient address 'to' is only meaningful inside transfer.
Amount 'tokens' is only consumed by the safe arithmetic calls inside transfer.
spender only selects the allowed mapping key written by approve.
Allowance amount 'tokens' is only written into allowed by approve.
'from' only selects the debit keys used by transferFrom.
'to' only selects the credit key used by transferFrom.
Amount 'tokens' is only consumed by the safe arithmetic calls inside transferFrom.
tokenOwner only selects the outer key read by allowance.
spender only selects the inner key read by allowance.
spender is the allowance key and the callback target inside approveAndCall.
'tokens' is stored in allowed and forwarded to the callback by approveAndCall.
'data' is passed straight through to the external receiveApproval call and is relevant only to that unsafe operation.
tokenAddress selects the arbitrary external contract that transferAnyERC20Token calls, directly determining the unsafe operation.
'tokens' is the amount forwarded to the external ERC20 transfer call, relevant only to that unsafe operation.
